title: Travel Completed | APPR | Controllable | Delay 6�<9 hrs | AC Wallet (20%) | Star Alliance Gold Profile
description:
Validates Tier 2 flight disruption compensation for a Star Alliance Gold member where the customer selects AC Wallet payout. A 7-hour controllable delay on a single domestic leg (Flight AC 431, YUL to YYZ) falls within the APPR 6 to <9hr delay band. The linked active Star Alliance Gold profile (Aeroplan 50K/75K/Super Elite or partner Star Alliance Gold) triggers the APPR dual payment offer, and the customer selects AC Wallet. Validates that the 20% top-up calculation is accurately applied on the Tier 2 statutory base ($700 CAD base + 20% top-up = $840 CAD AC Wallet). Confirms that DDS returns EL-02, Persona IDV passes, CyberSource returns GREEN, the compensation record routes to EIP/iFly (not Unifier), and the Claims Dashboard reflects Star Alliance Gold tier status with read-only resolution.

Actual arrival: 17:00 (7hr delay � Delay band: 6 to <9 hours). Arrival delay code: 11 (Late Passengers / Controllable). Flight status: Arrived (operated). Booking changes: None � no VOL or INVOL. Carrier: AC only. 72hrs: Elapsed (filed D+34). Time limit: Within 366 days. No duplicate case. Not employee, not infant. Aeroplan / Frequent Flyer: Linked (9876543210), Star Alliance Gold status active and in good standing (NOT frozen). CyberSource: Configured to return GREEN. Persona: Configured to return IDV PASS. Country of residence: Canada (CAD). Payment: AC Wallet selected ($840 CAD).
